summary: Kemco racing series, unrelated to the BBC TV show, spanning Gremlin's SNES racers, Nintendo 64 rally/spin-offs, handheld entries, and the Top Racer Collection revival.

entries.title: Top Gear

emulation.notes: Use accurate SNES emulation for the original soundtrack and split-screen behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Accurate SNES output with modern scaling

primary.why: Top Gear was developed for and released on Super NES, with the later Top Racer Collection treated separately as a compilation entry. The SNES release is the authentic route for the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the SNES version in bsnes, ares, MiSTer, or original hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2024 Top Racer Collection is a separate compilation/reissue entry.

entries.title: Top Gear 2

emulation.emulator: bsnes / ares / Genesis Plus GX / WinUAE
emulation.notes: Use SNES emulation as primary; other ports are historical alternatives.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Accurate SNES output with modern scaling

primary.why: Top Gear 2 first released on Super NES before later Genesis, Amiga, and Amiga CD32 ports. The SNES release is the original route and preserves the fuel/damage/upgrades balance described for the game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the SNES version in accurate SNES emulation; use Amiga/Genesis ports only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2024 Top Racer Collection is tracked separately as a compilation entry.

entries.title: Top Gear 3000

primary.why: Top Gear 3000 is a Super NES-only entry that uses the DSP-4 chip and adds futuristic upgrades, weapons, and split route tech. The SNES release is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play in an emulator with accurate DSP-4 support such as bsnes or ares, or on original hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Top Racer Collection reissue is tracked separately.

entries.title: Top Gear Rally

emulation.notes: Use PC for primary; N64 emulation for original branded release comparison.

primary.why: Top Gear Rally released on Nintendo 64 and was later ported to Windows as Boss Rally because Kemco owned the Top Gear name. Boss Rally adds three cars, an additional track, Quick Race, and up to eight-player multiplayer, making it the most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Boss Rally on a Windows compatibility setup; use N64 emulation only for the branded original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Boss Rally is the Top Gear Rally PC port under a different name, not an unrelated game.

entries.title: Top Gear Overdrive

emulation.notes: Enable Expansion Pak/high-resolution mode where supported.

primary.why: Top Gear Overdrive is a Nintendo 64-only sequel to Top Gear Rally with Expansion Pak high-resolution support, car upgrades, shortcuts, nitrous pickups, and a Grindstone soundtrack.
primary.how_to_play: Play in a Nintendo 64 emulator with Expansion Pak enabled and high-resolution mode available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or later port is sourced.

emulation.notes: Original hardware best preserves the rumble cartridge behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original GBC output with rumble on hardware

primary.why: Top Gear Pocket is a Game Boy Color-only rally entry, also known in Europe as Top Gear Rally, and includes a built-in rumble feature, 14 cars, eight tracks, and link-cable multiplayer.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Game Boy Color hardware for rumble, or use a GBC emulator for convenience.

entries.title: Top Gear Rally 2

emulation.notes: Enable Expansion Pak/high-resolution mode where supported.

primary.why: Top Gear Rally 2 is a Nintendo 64 release with licensed rally cars, dynamic weather, real-time damage, four-player multiplayer, and Expansion Pak support for 480x480 output.
primary.how_to_play: Play in a Nintendo 64 emulator with Expansion Pak enabled; use high-resolution mode where available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or later port is sourced.

emulation.notes: Use original hardware if preserving the Japanese rumble cartridge experience.

primary.why: Top Gear Pocket 2 is a Game Boy Color-only sequel, released as Top Gear Rally 2 in Europe, using an enhanced engine and adding battery-backed saving in international versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Game Boy Color version in SameBoy or on original hardware.

entries.title: Top Gear Hyper Bike

emulation.notes: Use high-resolution N64 emulation where supported.

primary.why: Top Gear Hyper Bike is a Nintendo 64-only motorcycle racing entry with three modes, six track layouts, and a track editor.
primary.how_to_play: Play in a Nintendo 64 emulator or on original hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or later port is sourced.

entries.title: Top Gear: Dare Devil

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution for the recommended route.

primary.why: Top Gear: Dare Devil is a PlayStation 2-only entry with city free-roam, coin collection, bonus missions, and unlockable cars/paint jobs.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation 2 release in PCSX2 at high internal resolution or on original hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or later port is sourced.

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original GBA output with modern scaling

primary.why: Top Gear GT Championship is a Game Boy Advance-only entry and launch-era Top Gear handheld game, with the Japanese release supporting the Mobile Adapter GB accessory.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GBA version in mGBA or on original hardware.

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original GBA output with modern scaling

primary.why: The 2003 Top Gear Rally is a Game Boy Advance-only rally game by Tantalus Interactive, with 3D car models and link-cable multiplayer.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GBA version in mGBA or on original hardware.

entries.title: RPM Tuning

emulation.notes: Use Windows as primary; Xbox/PS2 are fallback routes.

primary.version: Windows release / Midnight Outlaw: Six Hours To Sun Up
primary.why: RPM Tuning, also titled Top Gear RPM Tuning and Midnight Outlaw: Six Hours To Sun Up on Windows, released for Windows, PlayStation 2, and Xbox. Windows has the highest output ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a compatibility setup; use Xbox or PS2 emulation as fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: Regional titles include Top Gear RPM Tuning and Midnight Outlaw: Six Hours To Sun Up.

entries.title: Super Speed Machines

emulation.notes: Use DS emulation or original hardware.

primary.why: Super Speed Machines is listed as a Nintendo DS handheld entry in the Top Gear series. With only one sourced platform route, Nintendo DS is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Nintendo DS release in melonDS/DeSmuME or on original hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or later port is sourced.

entries.title: Top Racer Collection

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the recommended route.

primary.why: Top Racer Collection is the modern reissue entry for the Top Gear/Top Racer line, released on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Windows in 2024. Windows has the highest output ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release; use console versions for couch play or platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Collection/reissue entry; original SNES/N64/handheld games remain tracked as separate historical entries.
